entities.name: Eruth
entities.description: Young woman of Innistrad with clairvoyant death dreams, now a gibbering lunatic in the Natterknolls.

entities.name: Umbris
entities.description: Entity bound in a magical circle at Traublassen.

entities.name: Dark Lady
entities.description: Entity who helped Eruth evade captors and whom Umbris feared.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: Eldrazi whose arrival deepened Eruth's madness.

entities.name: Inquisitors
entities.description: Church investigators who declared Eruth a heretic.

events.summary: The Inquisitors declare Eruth a heretic and plan to execute her; she flees to the Natterknolls.
events.quote: Evading the Cathars, she fled Lambholt to the Natterknolls

events.summary: In Traublassen, Eruth is imprisoned as a possible sacrifice for Umbris.
events.quote: Eruth was imprisoned in the local keep

events.summary: Torens frees Eruth and, at her urging, breaks Umbris's circle; Umbris frees the villagers from their overlord.
events.quote: The entity accepted a temporary truce and freed the villagers from their evil overlord

events.summary: Eruth stays in Traublassen to guide the freed villagers.
events.quote: Eruth stayed behind in Traublassen to give guidance to the newly freed villagers

relations.quote: Eruth was freed by the former Cathar Torens
